messages.content: I'll keep that in mind—maybe I'll check a couple more pots tomorrow before watering again. It's just tricky when the heat makes everything feel so dry on the surface.

Sounds like a smart approach! Monitoring the soil moisture directly is a good idea. Just remember to check the top layer first—if it still feels dry, that's your cue to water. Good luck with the monitoring! Let me know how it goes!
That's exactly what I was thinking—checking the top layer first makes the most sense. I just hope I don't forget to do it when I'm distracted by the heat.

No problem at all! Sometimes when things are hot, it’s easy to get distracted by the heat or the day’s schedule. Just try to set a quick reminder on your phone to check those pots twice a day. It should help keep you on track! Hope the heat doesn't cause too much stress for your plants!
That’s a good idea—setting a phone reminder. I’ll do that. But I’m still worried about missing a pot if I’m not careful. Do you think I should mark them somehow? Maybe with a ribbon or something?
